The myLAB ecosystem offered by the BioneXt Lab is extending its features with the B-neXt CARE application which uses artificial intelligence to incorporate the most recent medical knowledge in the interpretation of your analysis results, taking into account the daily development of your biometric values. Thanks to the analysis results sent by myLAB and the information you have entered in the application or stemming from the connected health objects such as Apple Watch, the B-neXt CARE application enables you to: 
- Monitor and understand your vital signs (weight, heart rate, blood pressure) and your laboratory analysis results 
- Assess your physical and mental well-being score 
- Acquire good habits thanks to a continuous flow of ideas, recommendations and personalized health advice 
- Adopt healthy and sustainable habits that will have a significant impact on your health through smart coaching 
- Stay abreast of the latest health trends thanks to our selection of content disseminated every day 
- Get reminders concerning your next physical examinations 
- Make an appointment for a blood test via the Pickendoheem service or a medical consultation via the Doctena service 
- Follow the menstrual cycle for women 
- Manage your medication intake calendar 

B-neXt CARE uses Apple Health App to build an accurate profile, and retrieve real-time updates and tracking of your heart-rate, steps and more.
